name: University of Waterloo Plant Operations Floor Plans
description: Primary architectural repository for University of Waterloo facility drawings and floor plans. Source of drawing set 053E5_01FLR through 053E5_06FLR.

name: University of Waterloo Campus Map & Directions
description: Official interactive GIS campus mapping system showing building footprints, entrances, and Ring Road connections.

name: Engineering 5 (E5) Building Accessibility Guide
description: Details for wheelchair-accessible entrances, barrier-free ramped 2nd-floor main entrance facing Davis Centre, elevator bank on the Southeast side, and washroom accessibility.

name: Engineering 3 (E3) Accessibility & Inter-building Connections
description: Documents pedestrian overpass bridge linking E3 and E5 over Ring Road. Note: Contains conflicting descriptions regarding whether bridge connects via level 3 or level 5.

name: Faculty of Engineering Washroom Accessibility & Equity Directory
description: Documents accessible all-gender multi-stall washroom facilities (rooms E5 2901 and 2902) and standard single/multi-stall accessible washrooms.

name: Mechanical & Mechatronics Engineering Teaching Tools & Facilities
description: Inventory of MME specialized departmental rooms including E5 3101, E5 3102, and E5 3052 AV and presentation hardware.

name: E5-3101, E5-3102, and E5-3052 Facility Specifications
description: Room capacities: E5 3101 (114 seats), E5 3102 (118 seats), E5 3052 (20 seats seminar room equipped with Crestron video conferencing and smartboards).

name: MME Computer Labs & GEAR Computing Facility
description: Details on the Gear Lab in E5 2108: 50+ high-end engineering computing workstations running SolidWorks, ANSYS, MATLAB, NX, and Abaqus.

name: Sedra Student Design Centre (SDC) Facilities
description: 20,000 sq ft collaborative student design facility on E5 Floors 1 and 2, accommodating 25+ student competition teams, engine test cells, and machine shop annex.

name: Faculty of Engineering Labs & Rapid Prototyping Centre
description: Documents the Engineering Student Machine Shop in E5 1101 and the Rapid Prototyping Centre in E5 2002 (FDM/SLA 3D printing and precision laser cutters).

name: Systems Design Engineering Teaching Laboratories & Workshops
description: Documents E5 6005 (Systems Design Teaching Laboratory) and E5 6012-6013 (Undergraduate Design Electronics & Fabrication Workshop).
